about: The range basket. North America only. Each entry is a real mountain range, named for the range (`name`) with the place the view centres on (`landmark`): a lon/lat box around a roughly north-south crest, with a valley on at least one side for the camera. `node tools/build-ranges.mjs` fetches real elevation, traces the crest, picks the camera side, scores the skyline (RangeCharacter.js) and writes src/world/terrain/ranges/. Add an entry and rebuild to grow the basket; scores are absolute, so adding a range never re-ranks the others. `profile` points at a prebuilt profile instead of fetching (none do now: every range is built at the same 30m resolution). `side` (1 east, -1 west) overrides the automatic camera side.
